'''Den Velmor''' was the capital city on the planet, [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. [[17 BBY/Legends|Seventeen-years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Lorac]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Denira]] maintained the royal palace and operated in opposition to [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] gained a foothold on Velmor and took control of the capital city assassinating the king and queen. Prince [[Denid]] fled from Velmor, leaving his younger brother, Prince [[Anod]] (an Imperial sympathizer) behind. The royal regent, [[Zelor]], took control of Den Velmor and maintained its status as an Imperial city for many years.

[[3 ABY/Legends|Three years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Prince Denid returned to Velmor, deposed Zelor and Anod and took his rightful place as the planet's new king. From that point forward, Den Velmor became a city working in opposition to the goals of the Empire.
